info.title: Philanthropy Data Commons API
info.description: An API for a common data platform to make the process of submitting data requests to funders less burdensome for changemakers seeking grants.

get.summary: Gets a list of organizations as cached from Keycloak.
get.description: Returns the cached Keycloak organizations, each including its role bundle (changemaker, data provider, and/or funder) and its current cached members. The caller's JWT must carry the PDC-service `pdc-admin` realm role or at least one of the Keycloak `realm-management` organization-visibility roles (`view-organizations`, `manage-organizations`, or `manage-realm`).

post.summary: Kicks off an asynchronous task that replicates all Keycloak organizations and their memberships into the PDC organizations cache.
post.description: Creates an `organizationSyncTask` and enqueues a background job that lists the realm's organizations and their members at the Keycloak Admin REST API using the caller's own credentials, then merges them into the local `organizations` and `user_organization_memberships` cache. The caller's JWT must carry at least one of the `view-organizations`, `manage-organizations`, or `manage-realm` realm-management roles, and at least one of the `view-users` or `manage-users` realm-management roles, mirroring the sets Keycloak accepts on the equivalent organizations and members listing calls. The sync sets `disabledAt` for organizations that Keycloak reports as deleted or not enabled and for memberships Keycloak no longer reports, rather than deleting rows. Poll `GET /organizations/sync/{organizationSyncTaskId}` for completion.

201.description: The created organization sync task, initially pending.

get.summary: Gets the status of an organization sync task.
get.description: Returns the requested organization sync task, including its `details` summary once completed. The requester can see their own tasks; administrators can see all tasks.

get.description: Returns the caller's own user record, and additionally every other user when the caller's JWT carries the PDC-service `pdc-admin` realm role or at least one of the Keycloak `realm-management` user-visibility roles (`query-users`, `view-users`, or `manage-users`).

post.summary: Kicks off an asynchronous task that replicates all Keycloak users into the PDC users cache.
post.description: Creates a `userSyncTask` and enqueues a background job that lists the whole realm's user list at the Keycloak Admin REST API using the caller's own credentials, then merges it into the local `users` cache. The sync sets `disabledAt` for users that Keycloak reports as deleted or not enabled rather than deleting them. Poll `GET /users/sync/{userSyncTaskId}` for completion.

PublicChangemaker.description: The changemaker attributes returned to every caller, including callers that do not hold `view` permission on the changemaker and unauthenticated callers.

ShallowChangemaker.description: A changemaker without its children (`fields` and `fiscalSponsors`). Which attributes are present depends on whether the caller holds `view` permission on this particular changemaker.

fiscalSponsors.description: Fiscal sponsors (past and present) of this changemaker. Omitted unless the caller holds `view` permission on this changemaker. Permission is evaluated per sponsor, so entries the caller cannot view carry only the public attributes while the rest carry all of them; a single array can hold both shapes. The entries never include values for `fields` nor `fiscalSponsors` to avoid infinite recursion. Use the returned `id` to call $getChangemakerById for those details.

fields.description: For each base field, the best available value related to this changemaker. Can contain ProposalFieldValue or ChangemakerFieldValue objects. Empty when unauthenticated or when recursively querying changemakers, for example, within fiscal sponsors.

property.description: The entity data property to evaluate the condition against.

PermissionGrantConditions.description: Optional conditions that restrict when this permission grant applies. Currently, only the `proposalFieldValue` and `initiativeFieldValue` conditions are supported. Each key must be an entity type present in the grant's `scope` array; keys not in `scope` will be rejected.

contextEntityType.description: The type of entity a grant made from this default applies to. `any` is not supported.

DefaultPermissionGrant.description: A default permission grant grants no access itself and is never consulted when checking permissions. It is a permission grant template: everything a `PermissionGrant` carries except the key naming its context entity. A default permission grant combined with a newly created entity of its `contextEntityType` describes a permission grant.

PermissionGrantGranteeType.description: The type of grantee for a permission grant.

PermissionsMap.description: The authenticated caller's resolved permissions on this entity. Each key is a permission scope; each value lists every verb the caller holds at that scope, with `manage` verbs, `any`-scope grants, user group membership, all-authenticated-users grants, and the administrator role already expanded. Scopes restricted by grant conditions are omitted rather than overstated. Empty for anonymous callers and for funders embedded within another entity's response; shallow changemaker embeds omit the attribute, while fully serialized embedded changemakers resolve normally.

keycloakUserName.description: The full name of the user (described in OIDC 1.0 'name' standard claim) as of the most recent logged-in service activity or Keycloak user sync.

syncedFromKeycloakAt.description: The last time this row was confirmed against Keycloak by a sync; null until the first sync.

disabledAt.description: The time this user was observed as absent from or not enabled in Keycloak by a sync; null if the user is still live in Keycloak. The user row is kept for referential integrity.

details.description: The summary of the completed sync run; null until the task completes.

seen.description: The number of users found in Keycloak during the sync run.

added.description: The number of users created in the local cache by the sync run.

updated.description: The number of existing users confirmed against Keycloak by the sync run.

disabled.description: The number of local user rows marked disabled by the sync run because Keycloak reports them as absent or not enabled.

createdBy.description: The keycloak user id of the PDC user that requested this sync.

ProtectedChangemakerAttributes.description: The changemaker attributes returned only to callers that hold `view` permission on the changemaker. Every other caller, including unauthenticated ones, receives a response with these attributes absent rather than null.

keycloakOrganizationId.description: Optional, set this only when available. One can PATCH it in later if it becomes available.
